placeholders._note: longest path first; every string value is rewritten, in keys and values; applied before anything else

volatile_keys._note: key -> replacement; a value under such a key (at any depth) is replaced when it is not null

sort._note: list name -> keys of the sort tuple (missing keys sort as empty); lists not named here keep their order

stream._note: a stream method's out file is {items: [...merged...], end: <end.result>}; collector.collect merges to {asset, components, warnings, end}; source rows merge to {ops, end} in emission order with batch boundaries dropped
